  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ServiceForYourFridge">

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer service request and follow-up" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Event_AppointmentReceived" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForRepairOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForRepairOutcome" targetRef="Event_RepairCompleteReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForRepairOutcome" targetRef="Event_RepairNotCompletedReceived"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Center_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestReceived" targetRef="Task_SelectFacility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Center_2" sourceRef="Task_SelectFacility" targetRef="Task_SendAssignment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Center_3" sourceRef="Task_SendAssignment" targetRef="EndEvent_AssignmentSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ServiceFacility" name="Local service facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_AssignmentReceived" name="Facility assignment received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FacilityAssignment" messageRef="Message_FacilityAssignment"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeAppointment" name="Make appointment"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAppointment" name="Send appointment" messageRef="Message_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FacilityArrives" name="Service facility arrives at a random time"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairFridge" name="Repair fridge"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRepairComplete" name="Notify customer that repair is complete" messageRef="Message_RepairComplete"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ConfirmationReceived" name="Customer confirmation received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ConfirmationReceived" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RepairConfirmed" name="Repair confirmed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" name="Leave without repairing the fridge because additional parts are needed"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRepairNotCompleted" name="Notify customer that repair was not completed" messageRef="Message_RepairNotCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_LeaveWithoutRepair" name="Leave without repair"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_AssignmentReceived" targetRef="Task_MakeAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_2" sourceRef="Task_MakeAppointment" targetRef="Task_SendAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_3" sourceRef="Task_SendAppointment" targetRef="Event_FacilityArrives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_4" sourceRef="Event_FacilityArrives" targetRef="Gateway_PartsNeeded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_11" sourceRef="Task_SendRepairNotCompleted" targetRef="EndEvent_LeaveWithoutRepair"/>

rules.instruction: When the description states that one activity, event, or event outcome leads to another, including after a wait or along an alternative event path: Model sequence flows connecting the corresponding BPMN nodes in the described order, preserving transitions into and out of waiting events and each described alternative path.
rules.situation: the description states that one activity or event is followed by another, including across a wait or along an alternative outcome

rules.instruction: When the description states an activity or decision with a particular action, condition, scope, or criterion: Label the corresponding BPMN activity or gateway concisely and faithfully, preserving distinctions relevant to the described action or decision rather than substituting unrelated meaning.
rules.situation: the description states multiple distinct decisions, conditions, or optional actions in the same process

rules.instruction: When the description says a participant will arrive at an unspecified time and subsequent work depends on that arrival: model the wait for the arrival as an intermediate catch event, not as an event-based gateway waiting for a different outcome
rules.situation: the description says a participant will arrive at an unspecified time and subsequent work depends on that arrival

rules.instruction: When the description states a decision with distinct outcomes or a time-based condition that triggers an action;: Label the corresponding gateway or event with concise wording that faithfully identifies the described decision or trigger, preserving the distinction relevant to its outcomes.
rules.situation: the description states multiple distinct decisions or optional outcomes, each determined by a different condition

rules.instruction: When the description states that a process waits for a later occurrence before the next activity can begin: Model the wait as an intermediate catch event for the described occurrence, placed between the preceding activity and the activity that follows it.
rules.situation: the description states that a process waits for a later occurrence before the next activity can begin
